messages:
Elena - Alliances: Quick thread to finalize CloudForge co-sell rules for Nimbus Energy. Need credit splits, claim windows, and CRM tagging before Monday's joint demo.
Rohit - Sales Ops: Can we standardize: introduced vs collaborative vs poc_lead. Also prevent owner flip on existing accounts.
Ivy (CloudForge SI): From our side: introduced = 30%, collaborative = 12%, poc_lead = 40%. If CloudForge supplies infra appliances, add +7% hw bonus.
Ben - Finance: Add fields on opp: partner_id, partner_role, partner_credit_pct, partner_credit_locked_at. Lock credits at contract signature.
Elena - Alliances: Claim windows: SI portal intro -> AE has 6 business days to log outreach; if none, SI claim stands. After AE logs outreach, cohort moves to co-sell review. SI must ack intake within 48h.
Rohit - Sales Ops: CRM rule (pseudo):
```
if account.exists and owner != si.owner:
  create subop type='si_collab' tag='si:CloudForge'
else:
  assign owner = si.owner
```
Marta - Marketing: For marketplace listing & co-marketing: need 1-pager + 2-line marketplace blurb within 4bd after SI ack. Joint announcement requires 7bd written notice + legal signoff.
PartnerBot: auto: created partner-intake ticket PT-77011 for Nimbus / CloudForge. Ticket captures portal_ts and will post timestamps to #partner-ops.
Ivy (CloudForge SI): will ack PT-77011 and upload POC scope today.
Elena - Alliances: Summary: 1) Crediting bands as above. 2) Claim windows: AE 6bd, SI ack 48h. 3) CRM: create sub-op for existing-account handoffs. 4) Required opp fields for Finance. 5) Marketing timing: 4bd listing draft, 7bd announcement notice. I'll update the SI playbook and share PRD. Thanks :handshake:
